remarks: Welcome to this exquisite 5-bedroom residence in the desirable heart of Cos Cob, offering luxurious living at its finest. This beautifully renovated and expanded home boasts an inviting kitchen and living space, perfect for modern family living and entertaining. Ideally located near schools and scenic parks, it provides the perfect balance of convenience and tranquility. Unwind on your private terrace surrounded by lush greenery, perfect for relaxing afternoons. The primary bedroom suite is a retreat of comfort and elegance, featuring a beautifully updated bathroom with a triple-head shower and a deep soaking tub. The second level includes a sun-drenched office. Home has a spacious 3-car garage with ample storage space. Don't miss this extraordinary opportunity.
